issues.reason: Queries requires the pattern be built exactly as the matching statement, and no statement reporting something that happens to the lantern stores it in a To oblique (that head is reserved for a PP naming where/what the activity is directed at), so the query binds a goal-style slot instead of the undergoer role and matches nothing in the KB - not even the context's own (Around sk_scatter_1 sk_lantern_1).

gaps_confirmed: No undergoer-side analogue of "What does Bob do?": the event-class slot may hold a variable but a role head may not, and no role-union is licensed, so "What happens to X?" has no complete licensed form.
new_gaps: A licensed "what happens to X" form would have to carry an OPEN UNDERGOER: either an undergoer-neutral head, or a sanctioned union of query lines over Patient / Theme / Experiencer - the dual-storage-union list is closed and does not include alternative role heads.

Even a role-union would not reach an event linked to the entity only by a preposition-named or entity-attached oblique (here the context's (Around sk_scatter_1 sk_lantern_1)): there is no licensed "what event involves X at all" query.
defect_summary: The nearest licensed form drops the To oblique and binds the lantern in an undergoer role - (: $prf (And (Member $e $verb) (Patient $e sk_lantern_1)) $tv) - but since the undergoer head varies with the unknown verb and neither a variable head nor a role-union is licensed, the instruction set licenses no complete compliant form for this question.
notes: Referent handling is right: with CONTEXT the lantern is its constant sk_lantern_1 used directly, and only a query line is emitted.
